name: AML Alert Disposition Assistant
description: Reads the alert, the customer's 90-day transaction history and prior case notes, then drafts a disposition narrative with a recommended close / escalate call. The analyst always makes the final decision — the draft is evidence, not authority.
business_value: Analysts spend ~18 minutes per alert writing narratives. Draft-first cuts it to ~4.

name: Customer Complaint Triage
description: Classifies inbound complaints by product, severity and regulatory sensitivity, extracts the alleged loss amount, and routes to the right desk. Anything ombudsman-flagged skips the queue and pages the compliance duty officer.
business_value: Regulatory complaint SLAs are 30 days; misrouting burns a week. Auto-routing removes it.

name: Payment Failure Root-Cause Explainer
description: Takes a failed payment reference, correlates hub logs, scheme response codes and nostro funding state, and explains in plain language what failed and what to do — for L1 staff who cannot read ISO 20022 reject codes.
business_value: Deflects L1-to-L2 escalations on payment breaks, the single biggest ops ticket driver.

name: KYC Document Extraction
description: Vision extraction of name, ID number, address and expiry from uploaded ID and address proofs, cross-checked against the application form. Mismatches route to manual verification rather than auto-approving.
business_value: Removes manual keying from onboarding; feeds the Retail Account Onboarding workflow.
